children: Millrose Properties raised its quarterly cash dividend to 79 cents a share from 77 cents.
The real estate investment trust said the new dividend will be payable on Oct. 15 to shareholders of record as of Oct. 5.
The new payout, equal to $3.16 a year, represents an annual yield of 11.8% based on Wednesday's closing price of $26.81.
